title: Mansion of Secrets - Beta Open!
author: WuxiaScrub
selftext:
Mansion of Secrets is a turn-based multiplayer board game where one player controls Madeline, a hunter, while 3–6 others try to find and escape with their personal blackmail evidence before she catches them. Players explore a three-floor mansion by rolling dice, searching rooms for evidence and action cards, and using character abilities and cards to outmaneuver each other. The tension comes from hidden information (players don't know who has whose evidence) plus the ever-present threat of Madeline hunting them down.  
  
I used Claude for code, GPT for brainstorming/feedback, and Gemini for image generation. I started late March this year, solo, but with help of close friends for playtesting and quality control.

If anyone is interested, I would love to hear your feedback after playtest! [https://mansionofsecrets.com/](https://mansionofsecrets.com/) 

Also happy to answer more detailed questions about the game, tech stack, or development process.
